name: shopee_open_platform-mcp
display_name: Shopee Seller Centre + Shopee Open Platform MCP
description: Shopee Seller Centre + Shopee Open Platform (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, g

platform_mcp_shopee_open_platform_partne.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_OPEN_PLATFORM_PARTNER_ID
platform_mcp_shopee_open_platform_partne.description: partner_id of your Shopee Open Platform app (Console > App list).

platform_mcp_shopee_open_platform_partne.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_OPEN_PLATFORM_PARTNER_KEY
platform_mcp_shopee_open_platform_partne.description: The app's partner_key; signs the refresh request and every call (lower-case hex HMAC-SHA256) and is never sent.

platform_mcp_shopee_open_platform_shop_i.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_OPEN_PLATFORM_SHOP_ID
platform_mcp_shopee_open_platform_shop_i.description: shop_id that authorised the app (returned in the authorisation redirect).

platform_mcp_shopee_open_platform_refres.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_OPEN_PLATFORM_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_shopee_open_platform_refres.description: The shop's refresh_token from v2.public.get_access_token (valid 30 days, single-use). Each refresh (every ~4 h) returns a new one that replaces it (persisted when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set).

platform_mcp_shopee_open_platform_host.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SHOPEE_OPEN_PLATFORM_HOST
platform_mcp_shopee_open_platform_host.description: API host: partner.shopeemobile.com (global production), openplatform.shopee.cn (mainland China), openplatform.shopee.com.br (Brazil) or openplatform.sandbox.test-stable.shopee.sg (sandbox).

tools.name: me
tools.description: v2.shop.get_shop_info: shop_name, region, status, is_cb, auth_time and expire_time of the shop authorisation.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: v2.product.get_item_list: the shop's own NORMAL (live) listings — ids, status and update_time only (the API returns no titles or prices; call get_product per id). `query`/`category` are not applied. Seller-side channel API.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: v2.product.get_item_base_info: name, description, SKU, price_info (current/original price, currency), images, weight/dimensions and logistic_info of one listing (items with variations carry prices on their models).

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: v2.order.get_order_detail for one order_sn: order_status (UNPAID, READY_TO_SHIP, PROCESSED, SHIPPED, COMPLETED, …), total_amount, currency, epoch-second times and item_list in raw.

tools.name: track
tools.description: v2.logistics.get_tracking_info: logistics_status and the tracking_info events [{update_time, description, logistics_status}] of an order's package (split orders need the package_number, not supported here).
